Looks up the first exact key match in a project Sheet. Parameters: sheet_name, key_column, key, value_column, code_column, primary_terminology, mapping_columns. Column references are header names; mapping_columns is a map of terminology ID to code-column header (e.g. SNOMED-CT → snomed). Returns a complete DV_CODED_TEXT with the primary value/code/terminology and one equivalent TERM_MAPPING (match =) for each nonblank mapping cell. Missing key, text, code or primary terminology returns null; no codes are guessed. Keep codes as text to preserve leading zeroes/decimals. Sheets stay project data and are not bundled.
